title: European Defence Readiness
abstract: arXiv:2501.00058v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Europe's defence readiness is being tested by a deteriorating security environment, prolonged war on the continent and growing uncertainty over the future security environment. Against this background, the EU's White Paper for European Defence - Readiness 2030 identifies critical capability gaps, fragmentation of the European defence market and constraints on military mobility. This study assesses two dimensions of European defence readiness empirically: mobilisation readiness and whole-of-society resilience. The current-readiness assessment reveals substantial weaknesses in defence-industrial mobilisation relative to a 1990 readiness benchmark, particularly in production capacity, market fragmentation and security of supply. Whole-of-society resilience is stronger overall but highly heterogeneous across European allies, with the Nordic countries displaying comparatively high levels of preparedness and resilience. translated_abstract: 欧洲的防御战备能力正受到日益恶化的安全环境、欧洲大陆上旷日持久的战争以及未来安全环境不确定性不断增加的考验。在此背景下，欧盟《欧洲防御白皮书——2030战备》指出了关键能力缺口、欧洲防御市场的碎片化以及军事机动性受限等问题。本研究从实证角度评估了欧洲防御战备的两个维度：动员战备能力和全社会韧性。当前战备能力评估显示，与1990年的战备基准相比，欧洲国防工业动员存在重大弱点，尤其体现在生产能力、市场碎片化和供应安全方面。全社会韧性总体较强，但在欧洲各盟国之间高度不均衡，其中北欧国家表现出相对较高的准备度和韧性水平。
tldr: 本研究实证评估了欧洲的动员战备能力与全社会韧性，发现与1990年基准相比国防工业动员存在显著不足，而全社会韧性虽总体较强但各国差异明显，其中北欧国家的准备度最高。
